author: Alaann
title: Do not publicly accuse players of hacking!

replies.author: Porkyyy
replies.body:
Hello,

Unfortunately, this is not enough evidence to warrant a punishment. The most that this player would receive would be a verbal warn.
Thanks for your concern!

If you could, please try to follow the proper format when reporting a player next time, since it makes it much easier for us staff members to see who is being reported, and for what reason. Thanks!

Regards,
MLGPorky, Avicus Network Senior Moderator.
